subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Text Resizing and Reflow
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Text Resizing and Reflow.

hook.text: A user sets their browser to 200% zoom. Text overflows containers, buttons overlap, and the page becomes unusable.

buildup.text: WCAG requires content to be readable and functional when text is resized up to 200% without horizontal scrolling.

discovery.text: Reflow testing verifies content adapts to narrow viewports without losing information or functionality.

twist.text: Fixed-width layouts and absolute pixel sizing are the top causes of reflow failures.

climax.text: Switching from fixed to relative units and testing at 200% zoom fixes all reflow issues across the site.

punchline.text: Users will zoom. Content must reflow. Test at 200% minimum.

quiz.question: What causes most reflow failures?
options: Fixed-width layouts and absolute pixel sizing
